Install in Chrome or Edge

  1. Unpack the extension ZIP.
  2. Open the browser’s extension manager and enable Developer mode.
  3. Choose “Load unpacked” and select the unpacked directory.
  4. Visit the intended website, click the extension icon, unlock your vault and choose an entry to fill.

The extension is not listed in browser stores. It does not write the vault or support Firefox, Passkeys or cross-origin iframe filling. Actual browser installation verification and independent auditing have not been completed.

Host it yourself

Run npm ci and npm run release from the source package. Deploy release/web over HTTPS. See docs/SELF-HOSTING.md for Docker instructions and docs/DEVELOPER-WORKFLOW.md for the development and release workflow.

Trace this deployment

Production JavaScript is copied without obfuscation. Deployment metadata identifies the commit and Actions run; Asset SHA-256 manifest lets you compare downloaded assets with your own build. Cloudflare Pages Analytics is retained on the public site and may inject a script into HTML, changing its hash. Other assets can be compared directly. This improves traceability and does not constitute an independent audit.

Verify your downloads

Published SHA-256 checksums let you compare files; they do not replace signatures or a security audit. Keep independent backups and test with synthetic data first.
